summary.intent: Execute Phase 27 (writable-shares-poc) — implementing write-enabled folder sharing with permission toggles, IPNS key wrapping, and recipient write actions across 3 wave-based plans.
summary.outcome: All 3 plans executed and verified. Multiple UAT-discovered bugs were fixed during checkpoint verification, E2E tests written and passing (18/18), with the full writable share flow working end-to-end for both owner and recipient.

repo: Shared uploads previously set fileMetaIpnsName to empty string (''), making uploaded files unreadable after upload — this was a silent PoC limitation in useSharedNavigation.ts
The owner file update flow (useFileOperations.ts handleUpdateFile) did not re-wrap the new file key for share recipients — a pre-existing gap that only surfaced with writable shares
IPNS private keys must be dual-wrapped: owner's key in the FilePointer (ipnsPrivateKeyEncrypted) and recipient's key in share_keys with keyType 'file-ipns' — single wrapping breaks cross-party edits
TextEditorDialog save path used the owner's folder store (useFolder hook) — shared files need a separate onSaveSharedFile callback prop wired through SharedFileBrowser
Permission downgrade (shares.service.ts) clears encryptedIpnsKey but does NOT touch share_keys — file content keys remain accessible after downgrade
The cipher-box-ci-debug repo had no .env files — they must be copied from the cipher-box repo; web app falls back to window.location.origin+'/api' without VITE_API_URL, causing silent API mismatch
NestJS @ApiProperty enum decorators must be explicitly updated alongside DTO class validators for OpenAPI spec regeneration to pick up new enum values
SharedFileBrowser mkdir uses an inline input (.shared-inline-input-field), not a modal dialog — unlike the owner's CreateFolderDialog
SharedFileBrowser rename uses .shared-inline-rename-field for inline editing

code.finding: Old upload path set fileMetaIpnsName: '' — fixed by inlining full IPNS keypair generation with dual-key wrapping
Error 'File metadata IPNS name not available (legacy v1 file?)' thrown when fileMetaIpnsName is empty — needs guard for shared file context
Save handler used owner path (updateFile from useFolder) — needs onSaveSharedFile callback prop for shared context
addShareKeys authorization needed relaxation to allow write-share recipients to add keys to their own share
keyType enum was 'file' | 'folder' — extended to 'file' | 'folder' | 'file-ipns' to store recipient-wrapped IPNS keys
handleUpdateFile did not call reWrapForRecipients after file content update — recipients lost access after owner edits
Pre-existing TypeScript error unrelated to phase 27 — fixed as collateral cleanup

workflow: Background task notifications (task-notification) require explicit output file reads to retrieve results — killed tasks may still have useful output
Detached processes (nohup/disown) survive background task cleanup better than background tasks started via the Task tool
OpenAPI client regeneration requires the API server to be running with updated code — NestJS watch mode doesn't always hot-reload DTO decorator changes cleanly
IPNS propagation delays in E2E tests require page reloads and longer timeouts (30s+) for cross-user file visibility assertions
SDK packages must be built before web dev server starts — missing build causes immediate startup failure with unresolvable module errors
Playwright test failures produce screenshots in test-results/ that are readable via the Read tool for diagnosing selector mismatches

friction: Dev servers launched as background tasks were repeatedly killed by conversation context shifts — had to switch to detached processes (nohup) to stabilize
PostgreSQL host IP changed mid-session (192.168.133.114 → 192.168.133.12), requiring .env recreation and API restart
cipher-box-ci-debug had no .env files — required manual copy from cipher-box; web app silently used wrong API URL until VITE_API_URL was set
NestJS watch mode did not pick up @ApiProperty enum changes — required full API restart for OpenAPI spec to update
Git lock file conflict during commit required manual removal

E2E test selectors required 5 iteration cycles to get all 18 tests passing — actual CSS classes differed from expected (.share-recipient-permission vs .recipient-perm-write, .shared-inline-input-field for mkdir, .shared-inline-rename-field for rename)
OTP retrieval from API logs was requested 5 separate times during the session — no persistent auth mechanism for testing
open_items: Silent revocation (403 handling, [RW]→[RO] transition, IPNS key zeroing) and 30-second polling were not fully verified during UAT — listed in VERIFICATION.md as human_needed items
Files uploaded before the dual-key wrapping fix have unfixable empty fileMetaIpnsName — no migration path for legacy shared uploads
Owner file updates now re-wrap for all recipients on every save — could be expensive at scale; no batching or dirty-check optimization
The addShareKeys API allows write-share recipients to add keys to their own share — the security boundary of this relaxation should be audited
E2E tests depend on IPNS propagation timing (30s polling interval) — tests may be flaky in CI environments with slower IPFS nodes
phase 27 verification has 6 human_needed items that weren't explicitly signed off — approved by user as 'working well' but not formally documented in VERIFICATION.md
